info.summary: Batch 652 — UI and workflow defects, specimen pipeline and documentation consistency: peer averages, microtomy labels, Teaching Case, https-only links, barcode colour, triage gate, intraop carry, reconciliation, pool routing, Lockbox link, …
info.description: Vitest, 2026-10-23: full suite 1767 files, 14,789 tests (14,777 passed; the one explicit-any guard failure found in that run has since been fixed). Type-check clean. Targeted run of the 18 test files listed here (changed in Batches 650 to 652): all passed.

tests.comment:

PASSED: src/pages/contributionDashboardCalculations.test.ts (58)
Not tested or not built: Server-supplied averages for production; the peer definition and the minimum of three (decision for Pete).
